requirements.quote:
Because BGP-4 is capable of carrying aggregated routes that cannot be
   properly represented in BGP-3, an implementation that supports BGP-4
   and another BGP version should provide the capability to only speak
   BGP-4 on a per-peer basis.
requirements.condition: The implementation supports BGP-4 and another BGP version.
requirements.required_behavior: The implementation should provide a per-peer capability to restrict the spoken BGP version to BGP-4.
requirements.why_checkable: Per-peer version configuration and its effect on version negotiation can be inspected and exercised.
